retainedFailures: The first launch used a pointer capacity below the admitted range. The example now uses the existing default.
The default 250-entry Resource Timing buffer omitted late WASM and font entries. A larger controlled buffer and overflow assertion cover the observed request sets.
Default inspector cache evicted large source response bodies. A bounded CDP buffer in the same session and path/length checks bind the cold response bytes.
Rounded clipping refused native placement. The rectangular clip admitted it, and activation on mouse release resolved the native mouse-down focus handoff.
A subsequent click could arrive while a previous draw was finishing. Bounded ordered actions now retain their originating layer.
Independent browser review reproduced an unsupported name that survived export but broke reopen. Save now prepares the name with the same font authority before committing it.
Independent browser review reproduced a captured mouse release that saved after dragging outside. A fresh committed hit test admits release only on the pressed row.
The first draft guard left a valid blurred value awaiting matching geometry. The serialized handoff now admits that draft and supports refocus without saving it.
